title: Literature-derived comparison, decision, certification, and saliency mechanisms
description: Complete typings for the remaining twelve Section 10 literature-derived mechanisms. The records expose policy, calibration, model, and runtime conditions without selecting bindings, a pipeline, or an architecture.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.

notes: Stable identity of the supplied encoded artwork image.
Stable identity of this exact native decode.
The native opaque contract admits only decodes with no alpha-bearing pixels.
Inspection paths expose source identity, decode identity, and the opaque success condition without changing raster topology.

sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Weighted color/spatial distribution
artifactTypes.description: A finite normalized or unnormalized measure over declared color and optional spatial coordinates, with stable support IDs and nonnegative masses.
sourceNotes: Two such distributions are the natural inputs named at MECHANISMS.md:2202-2205.
provenanceNotes: Records support construction, coordinate units, color space, mass normalization, and whether the measure describes artwork, a field hypothesis, or a candidate palette.
A palette distribution is not an exact UI treatment and carries no role or publication authority.

artifactTypes.label: Unbalanced optimal-transport configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned ground-cost definition, mass creation/destruction divergence and penalties, regularization, solver, stopping, numeric precision, and deterministic tie policy.
sourceNotes: Makes the ground cost and mass-relaxation parameters at MECHANISMS.md:2204-2207 explicit.
provenanceNotes: Ground cost and mass penalty are exchange rates and require independent revision identity and sensitivity analysis.

artifactTypes.label: Unbalanced transport plan
artifactTypes.description: A sparse or dense coupling between stable support IDs, including transported mass and solver status under one pinned unbalanced-transport configuration.
provenanceNotes: Support IDs bind plan entries to both input distributions; nonconvergence is not represented as a valid plan.

artifactTypes.label: Unbalanced unmatched-mass account
artifactTypes.description: Per-support and aggregate mass creation, destruction, and unmatched-mass quantities for both sides of an unbalanced transport comparison.
provenanceNotes: Retains side, support ID, mass units, and mass-relaxation configuration identity.

artifactTypes.label: Unbalanced transport cost decomposition
artifactTypes.description: A diagnostic decomposition of movement, mass-relaxation, and regularization contributions, with objective and convergence values.
sourceNotes: Cost-decomposition output and scalar-judge warning at MECHANISMS.md:2205-2207.
provenanceNotes: This is an evaluation artifact, not a treatment score, selector, or product decision.

artifactTypes.label: Transport correspondence provenance
artifactTypes.description: Identity and derivation record for both distributions, their support ordering, ground cost, relaxation settings, solver revision, and execution status.
provenanceNotes: Preserves failed and converged executions without turning either into role evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Weighted attributed metric space
artifactTypes.description: A finite support with stable IDs, nonnegative masses, feature vectors and feature metric, plus a declared pairwise structural-distance matrix.
sourceNotes: The two weighted attributed metric spaces named at MECHANISMS.md:2215-2218.
provenanceNotes: Records support construction, feature units, pairwise-relation units, mass normalization, and stable ordering.
The contract is structural evidence, not a role assignment or complete treatment.

artifactTypes.label: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned feature cost, structural loss, feature/structure tradeoff, regularization, initialization, solver, restart, stopping, precision, and deterministic selection policy.
sourceNotes: Makes the feature/structure tradeoff at MECHANISMS.md:2217-2220 explicit.
provenanceNotes: Initialization and restart policy are load-bearing because the optimization is nonconvex.

artifactTypes.label: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling
artifactTypes.description: A coupling over stable support IDs from two weighted attributed metric spaces under one pinned fused objective and solver execution.
provenanceNotes: Includes initialization, restart, convergence, objective, and support-order identity; a nonconverged run has no valid coupling.

artifactTypes.label: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein diagnostic evaluation
artifactTypes.description: Fused discrepancy with separately reported feature and relation mismatch contributions, solver status, and sensitivity context.
sourceNotes: Fused discrepancy and relation-mismatch decomposition at MECHANISMS.md:2217-2220.
provenanceNotes: Diagnostic only: relation fit is not role correctness, preference, selection, or treatment authority.

artifactTypes.label: Finite structured hypothesis set
artifactTypes.description: A finite, stably identified set of structured hypotheses with no ordering, election, or product authority.
sourceNotes: Finite hypothesis domains are required by MECHANISMS.md:2245-2248 and 2272-2275.
provenanceNotes: Members may be masks, fields, or treatment candidates only when their own contracts say so; this set is not the exact UI treatment contract.

artifactTypes.label: Finite structured objective configuration
artifactTypes.description: A revisioned objective over stable structured-hypothesis IDs, including all terms, scales, feasibility rules, minimization/maximization orientation, and deterministic evaluation semantics.
provenanceNotes: A wrong objective can produce many diverse wrong answers and has no implied product authority.

artifactTypes.label: Diverse M-best diversity policy
artifactTypes.description: Pinned diversity metric or constraints, structural comparison domain, distance thresholds or penalties, generation algorithm, and deterministic tie/duplicate semantics.
provenanceNotes: Diversity semantics are policy and require revision identity and sensitivity analysis.

artifactTypes.label: Requested M configuration
artifactTypes.description: A positive requested count of distinct hypotheses, including behavior when fewer than M feasible distinct hypotheses exist.
provenanceNotes: M is explicit policy rather than an implementation default.

artifactTypes.label: Ordered diverse hypothesis set
artifactTypes.description: Up to M stable hypothesis IDs ordered by the declared generation/objective policy while retaining structurally diverse near-optimal alternatives.
provenanceNotes: Ordering is not final selection, and membership is not a complete-treatment authorization.

artifactTypes.label: Diverse M-best cost and duplicate trace
artifactTypes.description: Per-hypothesis base costs, diversity costs or constraint results, generation order, rejected duplicates, ties, and termination status.
sourceNotes: Base/diversity costs and duplicate/tie trace at MECHANISMS.md:2247-2248.
provenanceNotes: The trace evaluates generation behavior and is not a portfolio election.

artifactTypes.label: Submodular selection item universe
artifactTypes.description: A finite set of stable item IDs eligible for a declared submodular selection problem, without costs, values, or selection state hidden in the contract.
sourceNotes: Makes the item/hypothesis universe implicit in MECHANISMS.md:2261-2262 and explicit in 2274-2275 a typed input.
provenanceNotes: Items are candidates, not selected treatments or the exact product contract.

artifactTypes.label: Submodular target-cover item costs
artifactTypes.description: Nonnegative costs keyed exactly to a stable selection-item universe, with units, precision, and missing-item policy.
provenanceNotes: Cost units and revision are part of policy provenance.

artifactTypes.label: Monotone submodular coverage function
artifactTypes.description: A revisioned evaluable set function with declared domain, range, normalization, monotonicity/submodularity basis, precision, and marginal-gain semantics.
sourceNotes: Coverage-function input and proof/measurement condition at MECHANISMS.md:2259-2264.
provenanceNotes: Feature definitions encode authority; claimed approximation context is invalid unless assumptions are established.

artifactTypes.label: Submodular coverage target
artifactTypes.description: A declared target value in the exact range and precision of one monotone submodular coverage function, including target-reach comparison semantics.
provenanceNotes: The target is policy and is not interchangeable with a fixed cardinality budget.

artifactTypes.label: Deterministic selection tie rule
artifactTypes.description: A total, revisioned rule over stable item IDs for resolving exactly equal or precision-equivalent greedy marginal choices.
provenanceNotes: Includes numeric comparison precision; it does not hide random or iteration-order behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Target-cover selected subset
artifactTypes.description: The stable item subset selected by greedy minimum-cost target cover, with total selection cost and target-reach termination state.
provenanceNotes: This is a target-cover subset, not a fixed-budget subset, a partial preorder, or a selected UI treatment.

artifactTypes.label: Target-cover coverage evaluation
artifactTypes.description: Achieved coverage, declared target, uncovered amount, feasibility/termination state, and Wolsey-assumption context for one selected subset.
sourceNotes: Achieved coverage and uncovered-target outputs at MECHANISMS.md:2261-2264.
provenanceNotes: Approximation language is conditional on the declared assumptions and does not establish treatment quality.

artifactTypes.label: Submodular greedy marginal trace
artifactTypes.description: Iteration-ordered eligible items, marginal values, costs where applicable, tie classes, chosen IDs, cumulative value, and stop reason.
provenanceNotes: The trace binds to the exact universe, function, budget or target, and tie rule.

artifactTypes.label: Nonnegative monotone submodular value function
artifactTypes.description: A revisioned evaluable nonnegative monotone submodular objective with declared item domain, normalization, precision, and evidence for the Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher assumptions.
sourceNotes: Value-function input and guarantee conditions at MECHANISMS.md:2272-2278.
provenanceNotes: No guarantee transfers to nonmonotone, nonsubmodular, or additionally constrained variants.

artifactTypes.label: Cardinality budget
artifactTypes.description: A nonnegative integer maximum selected-set cardinality, with explicit behavior when it exceeds the eligible universe size.
provenanceNotes: Capacity is explicit policy and does not remove displacement.

artifactTypes.label: Budget-bounded selected subset
artifactTypes.description: The stable item subset selected by fixed-cardinality greedy marginal-gain maximization, bounded by the declared budget.
provenanceNotes: This is a fixed-budget subset, not a target-cover subset, partial preorder, or complete UI treatment.

artifactTypes.label: Submodular budget approximation context
artifactTypes.description: A report of achieved objective value, budget use, stop condition, and the verified, unverified, or violated assumptions governing any approximation claim.
provenanceNotes: The report does not establish treatment quality or authorize objective features.

artifactTypes.label: Multicriteria alternative set
artifactTypes.description: A finite set of stable alternative IDs to be compared, without embedded criterion performance, ordering, or selected-winner state.
provenanceNotes: Alternatives can reference treatments only through a separately typed candidate contract; this set is not itself a treatment.

artifactTypes.label: Oriented criterion performance table
artifactTypes.description: Criterion-by-alternative performances with stable IDs, maximize/minimize orientation, units, missingness, and numeric precision, but no hidden weights or thresholds.
provenanceNotes: Binds every row and column to stable criterion and alternative definitions.

artifactTypes.label: ELECTRE criterion weights
artifactTypes.description: Nonnegative criterion weights keyed to the performance table, with normalization, precision, and elicitation provenance.
provenanceNotes: Weights are policy requiring source and sensitivity provenance.

artifactTypes.label: ELECTRE pseudo-criterion thresholds
artifactTypes.description: Criterion-specific indifference, preference, and optional veto threshold functions, including units, direction, boundary comparisons, and missing-veto behavior.
provenanceNotes: Threshold and veto changes can reverse or make alternatives incomparable.

artifactTypes.label: ELECTRE III distillation configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned credibility-cut discrimination functions, qualification rules, tie handling, ascending/descending distillation procedure, intersection rule, and numeric precision.
provenanceNotes: This is specifically ELECTRE III-style distillation, not an ELECTRE I kernel.

artifactTypes.label: ELECTRE pairwise diagnostic evaluation
artifactTypes.description: Pairwise partial/global concordance, per-criterion discordance and veto activation, credibility matrix, and calculation trace.
sourceNotes: Pairwise concordance, discordance/veto, and credibility outputs at MECHANISMS.md:2287-2292.
provenanceNotes: This evaluation remains distinct from every preorder and does not select an alternative.

artifactTypes.label: Partial preorder
artifactTypes.description: Ordered equivalence blocks plus explicit incomparability relations over stable alternative IDs, with no forced total order or selected winner.
sourceNotes: Descending, ascending, and intersection preorder outputs at MECHANISMS.md:2287-2292.
provenanceNotes: The producing port identifies descending, ascending, or intersection semantics; none is a selected subset or treatment.

artifactTypes.label: Candidate observed-color theme
artifactTypes.description: A finite swatch set whose colors are witnessed in the source under explicit observation provenance, without UI roles, contrast claims, or complete-treatment state.
sourceNotes: Candidate observed-color theme input at MECHANISMS.md:2306-2309.
provenanceNotes: Observed colors do not establish role assignment, gradient state, contrast, or complete UI quality.

artifactTypes.label: Segmented image-theme features
artifactTypes.description: Revisioned segment, salience, reconstruction, diversity, and coverage feature values for one image/theme pair, with segment and feature implementation identity.
provenanceNotes: Feature implementation and segmentation revision must match the fitted model contract.

artifactTypes.label: Fitted theme-representativeness model
artifactTypes.description: Frozen coefficients or model state fitted from human-selected swatch sets, bound to training population, feature schema, split, fitting procedure, and model revision.
sourceNotes: Fitted-model input and transfer requirements at MECHANISMS.md:2306-2315.
provenanceNotes: Runtime admissibility is unresolved; transferring coefficients requires a new population, feature implementation, data split, and runtime decision.
The model predicts theme representativeness only and is not a role or complete-treatment model.

artifactTypes.label: Theme-representativeness prediction
artifactTypes.description: A model prediction for one candidate observed-color theme, including prediction scale, model identity, feature-schema identity, and out-of-domain status.
provenanceNotes: Diagnostic prediction only; it cannot select, rank by complete UI quality, or assign roles.

artifactTypes.label: Theme feature contributions
artifactTypes.description: Per-feature contributions or attributions to one representativeness prediction, in the fitted model's declared attribution semantics.
provenanceNotes: Contribution semantics bind to the exact model and do not validate the repository's hand-weighted currency.

artifactTypes.label: Frozen exchangeable calibration scores and losses
artifactTypes.description: A frozen calibration sample of scores and bounded monotone losses, with sample IDs, inclusion policy, order, and custody identity separated from per-item inference.
sourceNotes: Frozen calibration scores/losses and exchangeability requirement at MECHANISMS.md:2323-2329.
provenanceNotes: Calibration independence and exchangeability are load-bearing; per-item review data cannot enter runtime lookup.
Records population, split, exclusions, score/loss definitions, and immutable sample/custody identity.

artifactTypes.label: Conformal risk level
artifactTypes.description: A declared expected-risk bound and finite-sample confidence/error parameters in the units of one bounded monotone loss.
provenanceNotes: The risk level is protocol policy and does not turn multi-valid reviewer preference into a monotone loss.

artifactTypes.label: Monotone threshold family
artifactTypes.description: An ordered, revisioned threshold family with score orientation, inclusion semantics, endpoints, discretization, and proof obligation for monotonicity of the declared loss.
provenanceNotes: Threshold search and boundary comparisons are fully pinned rather than hidden defaults.

artifactTypes.label: Calibrated monotone-risk threshold
artifactTypes.description: The threshold chosen from one declared family, bound to risk level, frozen calibration sample, loss, finite-sample method, and calibration custody identity.
provenanceNotes: Not a cold-inference input unless calibration custody is separately frozen and admitted; the census currently marks runtime prohibited.

artifactTypes.label: Conformal risk-control guarantee
artifactTypes.description: A finite-sample guarantee statement containing controlled loss, risk level, confidence/error terms, sample size, assumptions, chosen threshold, and sample/custody identity.
sourceNotes: Risk guarantee with sample/custody identity at MECHANISMS.md:2325-2329.
provenanceNotes: This statistical guarantee is distinct from a per-item certified output, treatment, or runtime decision.

artifactTypes.label: Structured-output base mechanism
artifactTypes.description: A frozen executable mechanism contract mapping perturbed inputs to one declared structured-output metric space, including preprocessing, model/code revision, determinism, and failure states.
provenanceNotes: May wrap model-backed or algorithmic computation but must disclose runtime, preprocessing, randomness, and output contract; it grants no runtime admission.
It is an executable research artifact, not a graph binding to another census mechanism.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing perturbation distribution
artifactTypes.description: A fully specified perturbation distribution and bounded input threat set, including units, norm, radius parameterization, clipping, sampling algorithm, and seed derivation.
provenanceNotes: Randomness and byte determinism are separate claims; distribution and seed policy are load-bearing.

artifactTypes.label: Structured-output distance
artifactTypes.description: A revisioned metric or declared pseudometric over the base mechanism's structured output, with units, equivalence handling, and invalid-output behavior.
sourceNotes: Output-distance input and metric-risk warning at MECHANISMS.md:2338-2344.
provenanceNotes: The metric can ignore role or aesthetic damage and therefore carries no quality authority.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing sampling configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned sample count, batch policy, pseudorandom generator, seed, center-estimation algorithm, tie handling, resource ceilings, and failure policy.
sourceNotes: Sample-count input and repeated-randomized-inference constraint at MECHANISMS.md:2340-2343.
provenanceNotes: Resource conditions and deterministic replay requirements remain research-only and unresolved.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing confidence configuration
artifactTypes.description: Declared confidence level, finite-sample correction, allocation of error probabilities, and abstention boundary comparisons.
provenanceNotes: Confidence and abstention rules are explicit protocol settings.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothed structured output
artifactTypes.description: The estimated center in the declared structured-output metric space, present only when the certification procedure does not abstain.
provenanceNotes: This generic structured center is not a runtime treatment artifact or the exact UI treatment contract.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing robustness certificate
artifactTypes.description: A per-input certificate relating a bounded input perturbation to a certified output-distance radius or bound at declared confidence, with all assumptions and method revisions.
provenanceNotes: A certificate can cover a consistently wrong result and says nothing about semantic correctness.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing certification disposition
artifactTypes.description: Exactly one explicit disposition: certified with linked center and certificate IDs, or abstained with a reason code.
provenanceNotes: Keeps abstention distinct from a null center and from the certificate payload.

artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing sampling record
artifactTypes.description: Seed, PRNG, requested and completed sample counts, sample/batch identities, failures, resource use, base-mechanism revision, and execution environment.
sourceNotes: Sampling-record output and determinism constraint at MECHANISMS.md:2340-2343.
provenanceNotes: Replay metadata does not convert a probabilistic guarantee into byte-identical inference.

artifactTypes.label: IBP-compatible neural network
artifactTypes.description: A frozen neural graph and parameters whose every operation has declared interval propagation semantics, including preprocessing, numeric precision, training provenance, and runtime requirements.
sourceNotes: Compatible neural-model input and runtime restriction at MECHANISMS.md:2351-2358.
provenanceNotes: Runtime is prohibited unless a compatible neural runtime is independently admitted.
Training for tighter bounds changes the model and therefore requires a new immutable model identity.

artifactTypes.label: Neural input intervals
artifactTypes.description: Lower and upper bounds in the exact preprocessed neural input coordinate system, with perturbation norm/radius derivation, clipping, and source-input identity.
provenanceNotes: Bounds must match model preprocessing and do not imply native-pixel admissibility.

artifactTypes.label: IBP decision function and margins
artifactTypes.description: A deterministic mapping from bounded neural outputs to declared decisions, including class or role margins, threshold comparisons, tie behavior, and abstention semantics.
sourceNotes: Decision-function input and declared-margin condition at MECHANISMS.md:2353-2356.
provenanceNotes: Decision semantics and margins are policy, not inferred from interval bounds.

artifactTypes.label: Neural output intervals
artifactTypes.description: Sound lower and upper bounds for each declared neural output under one model and input-interval contract, including propagation precision and unsupported-operation status.
provenanceNotes: Loose intervals remain valid but may be vacuous; invalid propagation is not represented as sound intervals.

artifactTypes.label: IBP-certified decisions
artifactTypes.description: The possibly empty set of decisions proved unable to cross declared margins for all inputs in the input interval, linked to output bounds and decision-function revision.
provenanceNotes: Certified decisions are distinct from output intervals and from any treatment; a certificate says nothing about semantics.

artifactTypes.label: IBP vacuity and propagation status
artifactTypes.description: Per-output and aggregate non-vacuous, vacuous, unsupported, or invalid status with interval widths, failed margins, and operation attribution.
provenanceNotes: Status preserves looseness and compatibility failures rather than presenting every bound as useful.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned CIELAB conversion
artifactTypes.description: A complete sRGB transfer, XYZ matrix, reference white, adaptation, Lab formula, alpha policy, precision, and clipping configuration.
provenanceNotes: Conversion revision and numeric precision are behavior-affecting inputs.

artifactTypes.label: Frequency-tuned saliency smoothing kernel
artifactTypes.description: Pinned kernel family, support, coefficients or sigma, boundary handling, channel domain, normalization, pass order, and numeric precision.
provenanceNotes: Kernel scale can erase typography and small marks and is not a harmless implementation detail.

artifactTypes.label: Global mean CIELAB color
artifactTypes.description: A three-component arithmetic mean over the declared CIELAB raster domain, with source raster, conversion, inclusion mask, accumulation order, and precision identity.
provenanceNotes: Must derive from the same raster and conversion used by the saliency execution; split-field inadequacy remains visible.

artifactTypes.label: Frequency-tuned saliency field
artifactTypes.description: One finite nonnegative scalar saliency value per native raster pixel from smoothed CIELAB deviation from the declared global mean.
sourceNotes: Full-resolution scalar saliency map at MECHANISMS.md:2466-2470.
provenanceNotes: Dimensions remain native and values bind to conversion, smoothing, mean, distance formula, and precision.
This field encodes color distinctiveness, not ownership, attention, role, identity, treatment, or quality.

artifactTypes.label: Frequency-tuned saliency summary distribution
artifactTypes.description: Declared histogram, quantiles, extrema, and finite-value counts over one frequency-tuned saliency field, with bin and quantile conventions.
provenanceNotes: Summary identity links to the exact saliency field and aggregation conventions.

artifactTypes.label: Normalized-scale scalar saliency input
artifactTypes.description: The cited spectral-residual scalar image after explicit intensity normalization and scale normalization or resizing, with source transform and dimensions.
provenanceNotes: The cited normalized-scale form is runtime-prohibited because resizing changes source scale and selected frequency bands.

artifactTypes.label: Native-resolution scalar saliency input
artifactTypes.description: A scalar image retaining the native raster dimensions under a separately declared channel/intensity transform and no spatial resampling.
sourceNotes: Represents only the unresolved native-resolution reformulation named at MECHANISMS.md:2481-2482.
provenanceNotes: No equivalence to the cited normalized-scale method is claimed; runtime behavior and validity remain unresolved.

artifactTypes.label: Spectral-residual FFT configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned transform dimensionality, sign, normalization, frequency indexing, real/complex layout, padding and crop policy, log epsilon, numeric precision, and library/runtime revision.
sourceNotes: FFT conventions and padding/normalization risks at MECHANISMS.md:2484-2490.
provenanceNotes: FFT runtime, precision, and padding are behavior-affecting and must be independently admitted for cold inference.

artifactTypes.label: Log-spectrum averaging filter
artifactTypes.description: Pinned local averaging filter over Fourier log amplitude, including support, coefficients, boundary handling in frequency coordinates, epsilon, and subtraction order.
provenanceNotes: Filter support selects frequency bands and therefore cannot be implicit.

artifactTypes.label: Spectral-residual output smoothing
artifactTypes.description: Pinned response-domain transform and smoothing kernel, support, coefficients, boundary handling, normalization, and numeric precision.
sourceNotes: Output-smoothing input and answer sensitivity at MECHANISMS.md:2486-2490.
provenanceNotes: Response squaring/magnitude convention and smoothing are explicit rather than hidden implementation choices.

artifactTypes.label: Fourier log-spectrum residual field
artifactTypes.description: The log-amplitude spectrum minus its configured local average, indexed in declared Fourier coordinates and retaining phase linkage provenance.
provenanceNotes: This frequency-domain field is distinct from the reconstructed response and spatial saliency field.

artifactTypes.label: Spectral-residual reconstructed response
artifactTypes.description: The inverse-transform response reconstructed from residual log amplitude and retained phase before the declared output smoothing and final saliency convention.
provenanceNotes: Retains complex/magnitude convention, crop, and input coordinate identity.

artifactTypes.label: Spectral-residual saliency field
artifactTypes.description: A scalar spatial saliency value per output coordinate after configured reconstruction and response smoothing, with explicit mapping to normalized or native input coordinates.
provenanceNotes: This method-specific field is not compatible by identity with frequency-tuned saliency.
Spectral surprise carries no field ownership, role, identity, treatment, or quality semantics.
